notes.title: Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes: All the bugs reported have been fixed, and the game has been further optimised for fluid play time.

notes.title: Achievements Fixed!
notes.notes:
The Achievements have been fixed. They may not have been displaying properly, but this should now be sorted. 
Thanks for your patience with us, These are our first titles ever released on Steam.
Many blessings
